My name is José Ferreira and this is my website. In it, you will find everything that I think is relevant for me to share with the world. If you would like to know more about me, you can have a look at my [short CV](/assets/www/CV.pdf){target="_blank"}. My publications are up-to-date in [InspireHEP](https://inspirehep.net/authors/2094296){target="_blank"} and my code is made available on [Github](https://github.com/jpmvferreira/){target="_blank"}. To contact me, feel free to drop me an [e-mail](mailto:jose@jpferreira.me).
